content.short: WireMin is a decentralized social network that emphasizes privacy and security.
content.description: WireMin, founded in 2021, aims to liberate people from the monopolistic practices of Web2 giants and their violations of human rights, advancing a new era of open social networking with true free expression. It runs on a peer-to-peer decentralized network where messages are protected by end-to-end encryption, removing censorship, surveillance, and data collection. There is no central server, so there are no censorship or account bans. Users can create anonymous IDs without email or phone, and all messages, identities, and social connections are end-to-end encrypted for private, global chats.
content.meta: WireMin is a decentralized social network prioritizing privacy and secure, end-to-end encrypted messaging. Discover WireMin and other Web3 Social Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
